principle.source_of_record: Frozen experiment RESULT JSON when it exists; in E008 the recorded readiness JSON is NOT a main-policy result
principle.claim_authority: Exact recorded outcomes are distinct from truth in the world. Do not infer causality, legal rights, entitlement, or moral status.
principle.change_policy: If source is legitimately revised, preserve the previous version and update both report editions plus provenance; do not silently patch negative results.
principle.language_policy: Original 1 English and Original 2 Korean denote separate publication routes; original conception, rights and authorship are independently documented.

experiments.scope: 72 toy cases, history or classification sensitive 36, classification sensitive 17; role reversal and attack processing order caveats. Not field frequencies.
16 categorical cases, eight reversed pairs, five proposed baseline policies; 0 operationally runnable full comparisons. Readiness diagnostics only.
Recorded stress_primary (not base_diagnostic). Five policy numeric columns and negative survival outcome. Chosen synthetic weights, no empirical causal result.
Posthoc deterministic 108-combination grid and hypothetical irreversible-exposure bound, not field measurement or earlier unmerged E010 PR 20.

semantic_risks.meaning_en: Fraction of immediate extraction gain actually blocked; NOT probability of preventing an agent's exit and NOT a complete right-to-exit variable.
semantic_risks.meaning_ko: 현재 착취로 얻는 이익 중 실제로 차단되는 비율이며, 개체의 이탈 자체를 차단하는 확률이나 완전한 이탈권을 뜻하지 않는다.
semantic_risks.risk: Field naming can be read as the opposite causal direction, because 'exit prevention' usually means blocking exit, whereas higher modeled x reduces extraction gain.
semantic_risks.resolution: Do not rename frozen RESULT.json or run.js. Keep a source-field semantic alias in this machine-readable contract and require both reader editions to state the narrower meaning.

semantic_risks.risk: Two translations can agree with the same mistaken Markdown summary while diverging from actual result JSON.
semantic_risks.resolution: Recompute displayed five-by-five policy table from stress_primary and compare frozen English, Korean and historical result. Distinguish base_diagnostic.

verification_limitations: Deterministic parsed values and selected textual tokens only; not full semantic translation parity.
Results JSON and code were authored by the project; correctness relative to themselves is not independent implementation.
A changed frozen machine artifact is a new lineage requiring an explicit science/status review, not an automatic success.
Historical failed or unexecuted claims must remain visible in both reading routes.
